messages.subject: R GSoC next steps for STUDENTS
parts:
Students,

We're almost a week into the student application process. Normally, R
has received many more applications by this point than we have this
year.

I suggest posting DRAFT proposals to Google Docs, and making them
available to *comment* so that mentors may provide you feedback.

Please do this as soon as possible. You will need to submit final
proposals by next Friday, and getting feedback earlier has historically
been important to winning a slot and succeeding for the summer.

Regards,

Brian
